comment: Every into_inner, PoisonError, clear_poison and is_poisoned line under crates/ outside declaration lines, with the guarded value and a proposed action. Phase 0 of the foundation design is inventory only: no site is converted here. The detector lists candidates and never clears one: text cannot resolve symbols, so there are no exemptions; every site is needs_review, and the only actions are needs-review and fail-closed. A site the detector cannot classify is kind unresolved (recorded, never dropped): it reads text, not types, and does not expand macro-generated code. suggested_exempt is advisory only: where an X::into_inner receiver resolves, exactly and to the end, to a std type that cannot return a PoisonError (ManuallyDrop, Rc, Arc) at a written std path or std import, or to a repo type whose definition this repo can see with an in-repo into_inner, it carries a short suggestion; like state_bearing it never changes needs_review or action, and the phase 2 compiler-checked door (FD-2p) does the real proving. poison_recovery is certain where the site matches a positive poison shape (std-lock, channel-timeout) or the enclosing function shows a positive poison signal (PoisonError, Poisoned(, .lock(), .read(), .write(), .try_lock()); it is unknown otherwise; both stay needs_review. The detector reads text, not types, and does not expand macro-generated code; a type that reaches a site only through inference stays unresolved. state_bearing defaults to true; a recovery scope that only calls the documented read-only guard methods (len, is_empty, get, contains_key, iter, keys, values, first, last, clone, as_ref, as_str, to_vec, to_owned, copied, cloned) is proven read-only and false. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/build/poison_inventory.py`; the gate test fails if this file is stale.

kinds.unresolved: A candidate the detector cannot classify; needs_review, never dropped; suggested_exempt is advisory only.

actions.fail-closed: Stop swallowing: let the caller fail.
actions.needs-review: A candidate the detector cannot clear; a human must confirm it before allowlisting or conversion (the phase 2 compiler-checked door, FD-2p, does the real proving).
